Test step: Given a multi-country report on Overview or Category view
Expected result: Each market has a selectable checkbox and "All markets" shortcut is available

Test step: When the user selects one or two markets
Expected result: The dropdown trigger shows the market names

Test step: And when the user selects three or more markets
Expected result: The dropdown trigger shows the selected count (e.g. "3 markets")

Test step: Then if the user deselects every market
Expected result: The view falls back to "All markets" automatically

Test step: Given two or more markets are selected
Expected result: Overview and Category panels re-render for that subset

Test step: When any numeric metric is displayed (Share of Voice, Sentiment, etc.)
Expected result: The value is calculated from the union of raw responses (not an average)

Test step: And if a selected market has no data for a specific panel
Expected result: That market is silently excluded without error or empty state

Test step: Given the user has selected a subset of markets on Overview
When they navigate to any Category view in the same session
Expected result: The same market selection is applied on the Category view

Test step: And when they reload the page
Expected result: The selection is restored to what was active before the reload

Test step: Given the user opens a shared report link
Then the market dropdown defaults to "All markets" regardless of the sharer's selection

Expected result: The user opens the market dropdown

Test step: Then only that market is shown and no multi-select UI is displayed
